name: pb-codegraph
description: Magento 2 / Mage-OS impact analysis. v0.2.0 adds a deterministic codegraph-backed engine (augmenter + MCP shim) alongside the original LLM-driven impact check: callers, DI preferences, plugin chains, observers, cron data dependencies — before a deploy ships. Companion to pb-graphiti: pb-codegraph owns code structure & blast radius; pb-graphiti owns the why.
